title: The Names of God Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Names of God Bible Crossword
description: Solve a names of God Bible crossword: I AM THAT I AM, Jehovah, Immanuel, the Almighty and the Prince of Peace. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Moses asks what he should say when they ask who sent him, and gets an answer that is not really a name at all. The Names of God gathers the titles across the whole Bible — the Almighty who appears to Abram, the LORD set in small capitals where the Hebrew has four letters, the names Isaiah gives the child, and the I AM sayings of John's Gospel.
It is a Hard puzzle and a rewarding one, because each answer carries an argument. The closing verse is the answer from the bush.

clues.text: Rendered LORD in small capitals throughout the KJV
Isaiah’s name for the child, meaning God with us
God Almighty, as he appeared unto Abram
“I am the good ___” — one of the I AM sayings

verseText: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
